people.name: Haran
people.line: A city in Mesopotamia, associated with Abraham and his family.

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

translations.web: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.
translations.bsb: So now, my son, obey my voice and flee at once to my brother Laban in Haran.
translations.kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
